name: shadcn Table Maker
summary: Tool that scaffolds shadcn/ui data tables with search, pagination, sorting and CRUD in Next.js.
description: A table-building walkthrough for Next.js and the shadcn design library that produces form.tsx, column.tsx, data-table.tsx, page.tsx and types/table.ts for a data table with search, pagination, sorting, create, edit, delete and multi-delete. Forms are made in ShadCN Form Builder; the column and table code is built on @tanstack/react-table.
contains: generated files: form.tsx, column.tsx, data-table.tsx, page.tsx, types/table.ts
table features: pagination, sorting, search, create, edit, delete, multi-delete
two worked examples with copy-paste code
